settings.description: How far last season's scoring is pulled back toward the league average: 0 keeps it as it was, 1 makes every team average. A default, not fitted.

How slowly a team's in-season adjustment moves: each game moves it by 1 divided by (games played plus this number). Also the weight, in games, last season's per-game values carry in a player's blend. A default.
How many team-games of weight last season's league scoring level carries when blended with this season's. A default.
Points a home team is worth. Replaced by the mean home margin once 300 games are final, unless set by hand. A default until then.
The spread of one team's score around its projection, in points. Fitted from results; it has no default, and no range is shown until it exists.
The spread of the projected margin around the result, in points. Fitted from results; it has no default, and no range is shown until it exists.
A replacement player's scoring as a share of the league's points per minute. A default.
The share of the scoring missing above replacement level that teammates recover. A default.
The most a teammate's scoring is raised when others are out (1.35 is 35% more). A default.

1 keeps a team's projected score equal to the sum of its players' (plus a replacement-level line for minutes the capped players cannot fill) when the cap binds; 0 reproduces the workbook's own arithmetic, where the two can differ.
The chance of playing counted for a player listed as out. A default.
The chance of playing counted for a player listed as doubtful. A default.
The chance of playing counted for a player listed as questionable. A default.
The chance of playing counted for a player listed as probable. A default.
The chance of playing counted for a player listed as available. A default.
The largest share of a team's (or the league's) points allowed that may go to players with no listed position before defence-by-position indices are withheld.
